title: Python for Network Engineers
overview: This course is designed to teach network engineers how to leverage Python for network automation, configuration management, and troubleshooting. It covers Python scripting, network device interaction, automation frameworks, and real-world use cases. The course will help network engineers enhance their efficiency, reduce manual tasks, and improve network reliability.
methodology: Hands-on Practice – Writing Python scripts for network tasks
Live Demonstrations – Real-world network automation scenarios
Case Studies & Best Practices – Industry examples of network automation
Collaborative Learning – Group discussions on challenges and solutions
Capstone Project – Automating a real-world network infrastructure
competencies: Managing Network Devices using APIs & Libraries (Netmiko, Paramiko, NAPALM)
Using Python for Network Monitoring & Troubleshooting
Integrating Python with DevOps & Cloud Networking
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Write Python scripts for network automation
Manage network devices via SSH, Telnet, and APIs
Monitor network performance using Python scripts
Integrate Python with network automation tools like Ansible & Nornir
Work with cloud networking and SDN automation

outline.title: Module 1: Introduction to Python for Network Engineering

items.text: Why Python for Networking?
Setting up the Python Development Environment (VS Code, PyCharm, Jupyter)
Introduction to Python Scripting Basics (Data Types, Loops, Functions, OOP)
Working with Python Virtual Environments & Dependency Management
Introduction to Network Automation & its benefits
Overview of Networking Protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP, SSH, Telnet, SNMP, REST APIs)
Introduction to Automation Libraries (Netmiko, Paramiko, NAPALM, PyATS)

outline.title: Module 3: Managing Network Devices with Python

items.text: Connecting to network devices using SSH & Telnet (Paramiko & Netmiko)
Automating Device Configuration & Backup
Running Commands on Cisco, Juniper, and Arista devices
Using NAPALM for multi-vendor network automation

outline.title: Module 4: Network Monitoring & Troubleshooting with Python

items.text: Using Python for Ping, Traceroute, and Port Scanning
Automating SNMP Monitoring & Log Analysis
Real-time Syslog & NetFlow Analysis
Writing Python scripts for Network Health Checks
Understanding REST APIs & JSON Data
Working with Cisco’s RESTCONF & NETCONF APIs
Automating Cloud Networking (AWS, Azure)
Extracting network data using Python
Introduction to Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
Automating device configurations using Python & Ansible
Writing Ansible Playbooks for Network Automation
Using Nornir for large-scale automation

outline.title: Module 7: SDN & Cloud Networking with Python

items.text: Understanding Software-Defined Networking (SDN)
Automating Cloud Networks using Python SDKs (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Managing Cisco ACI, OpenFlow, and VMware NSX with Python
Introduction to Network Function Virtualization (NFV) & Cloud APIs
Automating Security Audits with Python
Implementing Firewalls & ACL Automation
Writing scripts for DDoS Detection & Intrusion Prevention
Automating Compliance Reporting
Capturing Syslogs & SNMP Traps using Python
Sending Automated Alerts (Slack, Email, Webhooks)
Generating Network Reports & Dashboards using Python
